requirements.requirement: The system must define a Pydantic model that includes fields for inclusion_criteria_count and exclusion_criteria_count as non-negative integers.
The system must include a severity_weighting field representing relative strictness impact as a float between 0 and 1.
The system must include a normalized_strictness_score field constrained to a float between 0 and 1 inclusive.
The system must validate that normalized_strictness_score is computed or provided and cannot be null in valid model instances.
The system must enforce that inclusion_criteria_count and exclusion_criteria_count default to 0 if missing in input data.
The system must reject model instantiation if any count field is negative.
The system must reject model instantiation if normalized_strictness_score is outside the range 0 to 1.
The system must support serialization of the strictness schema into JSON compatible with existing clinical trial response structures.
The system must allow the strictness schema to be attached to existing clinical trial model objects without breaking backward compatibility.
The system must define a scoring contract that specifies normalized_strictness_score increases as exclusion criteria and severity_weighting increase.
The system must ensure the scoring contract documentation clearly defines input fields, expected ranges, and output semantics.
The system must handle missing eligibility data by producing a valid schema instance with counts set to 0 and a default normalized_strictness_score of 0.
The system must raise a validation error when input types for counts or score are non-numeric.
The system must support extensibility of the schema to include future strictness-related attributes without requiring breaking changes.
The system must ensure the schema can be consumed by downstream scoring logic without additional transformation.
